records.issue_text: Double-checked locking in webassets.go is missing the second cache check after acquiring the write lock, allowing concurrent requests to all perform the full asset rebuild (cache stampede) instead of returning the cached result
records.rationale: The diff implements a read-then-write locking pattern: it reads `entryPointAssetsCache` under `RLock()` and returns if non-dev and non-nil, then always acquires `Lock()` (`entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock(); defer ...Unlock()`) without re-checking the cache after acquiring the write lock. This means multiple goroutines that observe `nil` in the initial read can all proceed into the critical section and rebuild assets sequentially even if a previous goroutine already populated the cache, i.e., missing the second check causes redundant rebuilds (a cache-stampede style issue).
